user_query: trass stories from the last 3 mondays

intent.goal: find Trass story content from the last 3 Mondays

generated_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  u.page_id,
  u.title,
  u.created_time,
  u.database_name
FROM unified_content u
WHERE u.database_name IN ('trass.stories', 'stories', 'trass.journal', 'trass.cpj')
AND strftime('%w', u.created_time) = '1'
AND u.created_time >= date('now', '-21 days')
AND u.created_time <= datetime('now')
ORDER BY u.created_time DESC
LIMIT 1000
